lists_fallback.what: The rows of the wpa-lists job's NUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv dated 1789-1900 or citing a Richardson volume ('VI R 122'), and the rows of its UNNUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv citing Richardson in any column; copied unchanged. Used only when jobs/wpa-lists/output is absent (that job is on its own branch until merged).

volumes.title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents, 1789-1897, Volume VI (Abraham Lincoln, Andrew Johnson; March 4, 1861 to March 4, 1869)

volumes.extractor: pypdf 6.20.1 extract_text(), NUL characters removed; the layer is Google's OCR
volumes.raw_extractor: pdftotext 4.06 (xpdf) -raw -enc UTF-8, only for the pages where pypdf gives one or two words per line (more than 30% of 20+ lines); the job joins those runs of short lines

extra_documents.note: Civil service rules adopted by the President, printed after his special message of December 19, 1871 (SPECIAL MESSAGES, pp. 157-159); they have no dateline of their own, so the date is the message's. Located by reading; configured, not machine-found.
